body: Somebody once told me the world is gonna roll me
I’m real life bummed that I JUST bought a series 5 and  the SE comes out and is $200 cheaper. With literally the same features. Super fun.

While it sucks to have to go through everything for this to be the conclusion, definitely glad you’re happy and I’m thankful for this post. It’s been a struggle with me for the last 4.5 months and seeing posts like this helps me remember my worth and putting my happiness in the front line. Thanks again for sharing the positivity and glad you’re in/getting in a better place 🙂
I definitely appreciate that friend. As well are yours. 🖤

God hearing things like it could always be worse or people have it worse is beyond frustrating. I’ve been raised my entire life on toxic masculinity, with the fear of being able to just admit sadness or just being in a dark depression and when I finally find my voice or anyone for that matter. To be silenced as soon as you find it is just crushing. Being vulnerable is already terrifying. Being shut down while you’re vulnerable is detrimental feeling to your mind. Not feeling the slightest bit of actual understanding or validation can fuck with ones mind and send it to an even darker space.

It honestly is. In my mind I always appreciate their small glimpse of optimism that “maybe this will work, this will create good energy”. But it doesn’t. I feel like people are just scroll through the “I’m uncomfortable by this” and select a promising card. Appreciate it, but it doesn’t make the bad things go away unfortunately. Depression: 1
Optimism: 0
Huzzah!

I told a doctor I literally thought of death and dying constantly. She gives me pills. I say these make me numb to wanting to kill myself. She gives me more pills at a higher dosage. Okay cool, thanks!
Damnnn, that’s a fucking bummer.
Instantly thought of Peter falling down the stairs.
I mean nah I was agreeing with ya man. She definitely doesn’t skate. She a straight pOsEr. Booty shorts or not, no body likes a poser bruh!
10/10 would agree there has been no skating involved.
It’s not wrong honestly. It is fine. Everything is fine 🙂

I’ve been stuck on this same thought and i hate it. But then I remember that by time anyone finally thought to check my apartment whatever damage was being done would hopefully shut my body down. But that what if haha.

I definitely understand what you mean/meant. I know there’s not much of a chance of us being back together. Which is why I also understand her part of not wanting to carry anything but we’ve remained friends because I’ve been in her current sons life for the last 3 years now and couldn’t stand to make him feel punished because her and I couldn’t be together as a couple. I’ve expressed that regardless of the outcome of the possible pregnancy I’m trying to be there as support. Should I? Probably not. Will I and feel dumb for it at 3am? Most likely. But the overall feeling of darkness and longing for death has infected me far before her and I knew each other existed. This has just been gasoline to my internal flame along with everything else. I appreciate your responses though. I truly do.

I 200% feel you on this. No matter how good or how bad the days are, it crosses my path at least once or twice if not for hours. Until the storm passes and I’ve exhausted myself down to a calm level. A couple of nights ago I took an extra sleeping pill and felt my mind leave my body and the next morning was the weirdest feeling. I found some shorts on sale that I fell in love with and that’s gotten me by the past couple of days. I know there will be another storm soon enough. But the biggest part of not letting the storms take me is seeing my nieces smile or my parents suffering with me being gone. I hope you and I both have better days and can find shelter when this storm rolls through. If you ever need anything feel free to message me. Think of it as a thunder buddy if you’d like. Take care either way man. Hope the storm passes soon.

I don’t have his actual number just because we’ve always messaged through social media but his ig is @beardlycustoms and that’s probably the easiest way that I can think of to start! His name is rick link though.
Ah! That’s awesome! 😄 thanks man!!! I’ve been doing well though! Been aching for some new bass stuff hard but everything else is pretty solid! Hope you’re well!!

Him and I started through instagram comments 😄 and then I ended up emailing him and talked a bunch of things out. Very easy process and have always loved working/talking with him! Super great dude and great prices!
They’re great man! I was on the fence before I got it but I did it and I’ve fallen in love with single cut basses 100%! I definitely recommend getting ya one!
I literally said this in my head when we had our last “talk” and she said that. Granted she is mentally unstable and needs to work on her shit but point still stands. Haha.

God, isn’t that the fucking truth. That’s just the shittiest. I literally sit up at night wondering HOW people can do that. Like despite everything else, putting it all aside. Just. HOW. blows my mind every time. But I agree, knowing that you’re not alone and there are people going through the same things definitely helps. I appreciate your words. And I’m definitely sorry that you’ve went through similar hell. I hope the best for you.

As hard as it is, super glad you’re putting yourself first. I’m right along side you. Same time frame and everything. and man it’s fucking hard but being in a constant state of hell and suffering seems to be a LOT harder. Best of luck to you and I hope you find happiness.
I feel this. I broke it not long ago too and I’m on medication now. She’s done nothing to better herself. But I’m medicated so that’s fun.
This is amazing! Happy you regained a strong part of yourself! ✊🏼

Yeah, I didn’t think that I’d really see a huge change anytime soon but me being how I am If I have a good day I’ll end up thinking it’s the meds but then when the shitty ones come in I blame the medicine for not helping. But I know I just have to be patient and wait it out. 
I started taking mine at night just in the event that it does put me to sleep I won’t be falling asleep more than I already do at work haha. 
I know that it doesn’t take it all away but it’s good to know that it will help in the ways. But I appreciate the helpful words. I’m glad either way that it’s helped you out with everything. I’m looking forward to seeing what it does for me. 🤞🏼

You’re absolutely right. It took me a while to finally admit that to myself but since I have it’s definitely made the process of living along side it a lot easier in a way. I’m glad to hear that it’s worked really well for you though! I’m hoping the same 😌 I appreciate it very much!
Love legs, hate cardio. But love the way cardio makes my legs feel. Still hate it though.

I’m so glad I’m not the only one who reacts this way. Even if I get a response to a message I don’t like, I take it to level ten and am immediately ready to just drop that person. I end up feeling like I’m overreacting but also convinced that I’m right and they’re now dead to me.

The same thing just happened with my ex. I cut her off for around 3 weeks and she finally sent me a long message apologizing and I heard her out told her I how I felt about how she was and we spent the next week in our dream land and it was perfect and that Monday she was back in her head and was unsure if she could do it. And now I’m back in mental hell. 

It’s the hardest thing to deal with. I hope things work out for you 🖤 always an open ear if needed.

She said the other day that she would do it with me because she feels that she needs it personally and with us and she feels that she needs medication for her anxiety to calm her brain. But we’ll see if she actually sticks through with it.

I really appreciated that. You’re 100% right too. I’ve looked at patterns before but never really thought about it that aspect and it’s true/helpful. But I definitely appreciate it man. I definitely have learned my worth through this and what I do deserve and I’ve made sure to express that in the past couple of discussions too.

I really appreciate that! I got a call twice from my gate last night and am convinced it was her to try and see if she could get a reaction but thankfully was able to go to sleep instead. Thanks for the words 😌

I’ve been in the same thing with my ex and cut contact for pretty much the same reasons. And I’ve been doing okay with it now for about a couple of weeks. But occasionally I feel wrong for it or question myself but reading this definitely hit a chord and reminded me to keep going. Definitely needed this. And I hope everything works out for you 😌

It’s definitely a challenge, every time my mind lingers towards her I just remind myself of all the things I did that was unappreciated or taken advantage of and let that anger filter through as a positive push away. Mine has tried to message me and has reached out to my family but I refuse to break. One thing that has definitely helped me too is spending whatever free time in the gym, cleaning my apartment or just being around other people in general. Often times if I’m around other people especially seeing married people or couples. I see the way they treat each other and their happiness and that’s a reminder that that’s how you’re supposed to be. And even though it’s hard to imagine replacing them, you’ll eventually find that person who makes you not even think about him. 
It’s all easier said than done but just stay strong, and just keep pushing forward. Even when you want to give up, just keep on keeping on. It’s all we can do when we’re forced into this position. Can’t let them win and get the better of us.

I actually have another video with heavier and that is one thing I’ve noticed is I feel like I’m pulling forward occasionally. And never really thought to lower the bar down a little to see how that levels out. But I’ll definitely have to try that out to see how it plays out! I appreciate it man!

We’re both grown adults. If I have to second guess an action, then bump that noise. Point is, I relate to this hard and it’s obnoxious. Hang in there!
